bounding_box_analysis.coordinate_system: EPSG:2992 horizontal; elevations in US survey feet
limitations: Coverage describes rectangular dataset bounds, not actual point density or valid data at every location.
Building-point elevation range is not building height.
Canopy cover and impervious-surface area are not calculated from point counts alone.

spatial_matching.note: The selected street image has not been spatially matched to a LiDAR bounding box. Do not interpret these sources as measurements of the same exact location.

limitations: Street scene classes are model predictions, not verified ground truth.
Walkability score is a preliminary sample-relative proxy, not a validated safety score.
LiDAR summary statistics describe the source dataset and are not site-specific unless a bounding-box analysis is performed.
Street imagery and LiDAR have not been spatially matched.
